commit 06c52a61e90c29c8f933d5e929bc9c1fbe595ea7
Author: Carlos Villela <cv@lixo.org>
Date:   Wed Nov 11 16:59:08 2026 -0700

    ci: act as the pi-action-agent GitHub App in pi-assistant.yml (#40)
    
    GITHUB_TOKEN can't open pull requests in this repository, and its pushes
    don't trigger workflows, so pi left #38 as a branch without a PR or CI.
    The workflow now mints a token for the pi-action-agent App, as cv/pit's
    does: commits as the App's bot user, ignores events from bots so pi's own
    comments don't start runs, and keeps concurrency at the job level.
    
    The client ID is a secret rather than a variable because the npm
    actionlint used by lint:actions (1.6.x) doesn't know the vars context.
